name: Rocko
summary: Rocko is an old friend/hustling acquaintance from Tallahassee who has repeatedly reached out since Aug 2024 — mostly asking for business advice, pitching investment opportunities (a $825 Hawaiian-shirt merch deal promising 50% ROI in 4 weeks), and looking for a leg up after a business that made ~$168k in its first 6 months collapsed. He has never bought anything; instead he acts as a referral source, sending over a potential OF-management client (Divina, +1 727-307-3967) in Jan 2026 and, in Jul 2026, forwarding a Facebook post from 'Mikey Conlon' whose Instagram accounts (Mikey C Preventative Health/Bio Hacking, Mikey KO Peps Peptides/Reta King, Reverse Holorambe Pokemon TCG) were all suspended on Jul 16-17, 2026. The phone owner confirmed 'Yes 1000% / I can fix if he needs' and Rocko passed along the IG handle. Follow-up: check whether Mikey Conlon ever reached out for the IG unban work, and be aware Rocko repeatedly asks for money/loans.
key_facts: Introduced himself 2024-08-15 as 'Rocko from tally' (Tallahassee); knows owner from past hustling
Claims a prior business did ~$168k in first 6 months before failing; blames unreliable team
Repeatedly pitched investments — most concrete: needed $825 for Hawaiian shirt merch order, promised $1,650 back in ~4 weeks (2026-02-12)
Runs/promotes 'wallprintpros' Instagram and DJ merchandising brand; claims EDM industry connections
Referred an OF creator named Divina, +1 (727) 307-3967, looking for a manager (2026-01-24) — 'good numbers but terrible management'

Referred Mikey Conlon (Jul 2026) — multiple Instagram accounts suspended 7/16-7/17/2026: Mikey C Preventative Health/Bio Hacking, Mikey KO Peps Peptides/Bio Hacker/Reta King, Reverse Holorambe Pokemon TCG; also a locked 'luckyedgemarketing' account
Owner replied 'Yes 1000%' / 'I can fix if he needs'; Rocko sent Mikey the owner's IG on 2026-07-24
Asked on 2025-12-06 whether owner does brand marketing
Has a step-daughter; describes himself as broke, working a regular job, no family/loan access
